title: Overview
html: Profiles, files, sessions and application execution remain local. Optional managed Kareer AI in Chrome/Firefox uses a payment and AI gateway. Advanced BYOK connects directly to OpenRouter; the userscript remains BYOK.

title: Information Stored Locally
html: Your browser stores profile facts, work history, preferences, saved answers, notes, sessions, settings and documents. Files remain local unless attached to applications or exported. Backups contain personal profile, settings, memory and job data, but exclude API keys, license credentials and checkout secrets. Export backups before reinstalling; the server has no copy of local files.

title: Information Transmitted When AI Features Are Used
html:
Autofill, option discovery, repairs, rewrites and document writing send relevant profile facts, resume context, notes, job descriptions, questions and choices over HTTPS. Automatic follow-ups can make additional requests.

Managed AI travels from the privileged extension background through https://api.kareer.itsamro.me (Cloudflare Worker) to OpenRouter and its downstream provider. The gateway holds prompts and outputs in memory during the bounded request and does not persist them. Advanced BYOK travels directly from the privileged background or userscript host to OpenRouter and your selected provider.

External providers have their own terms and retention practices; Kareer does not promise zero external retention. Avoid unnecessary sensitive information. Local features remain available without paid AI.

title: Credentials and Activation
html: A personal reusable Lemon Squeezy key authenticates managed AI. Anyone with the key can spend your shared wallet. Raw keys and private checkout claim secrets stay in privileged background storage, excluded from content snapshots, backups, page DOM and logs. The gateway stores hashes and verified payment identifiers. Keys are not device locked. BYOK keys stay local and are never sent to the gateway. Changing connections is explicit; credit exhaustion never silently spends a personal key. Removing one credential preserves the other.

title: Payments and Usage Accounting
html:
Lemon Squeezy hosts checkout, processes payments, issues receipts and keys, and provides its portal. Kareer receives no card details and creates no accounts or passwords.

Cloudflare D1 stores billing identifiers, credential hashes, grants/debits, subscription state, request IDs and input hashes, status, token counts, provider cost, latency and error codes. Request deduplication records are retained for 30 days with periodic cleanup. Payment and credit ledgers remain for entitlement and financial reconciliation. Prompts, outputs, raw keys and authorization headers are never persisted in application logs or the database. Infrastructure processes IP addresses and request metadata to provide and secure its services.

title: Credits, Cancellation and Charging
html:
Launch pricing is US$10/month for 1,000 credits per paid billing period, or US$5 once for 300 non-expiring credits. Taxes may apply. Monthly credits expire at period end and are spent first. Cancel in Manage billing; the paid allowance remains until expiry. Packs need no subscription and remain after cancellation. Failed renewals grant nothing new.

Each completed AI request costs one credit, including automatic follow-ups, repairs and rewrites. A run may use multiple credits. Oversized inputs, provider errors, timeouts, truncated or invalid completions are not charged. A validated, settled completion remains charged if delivery fails or an application rejects it. Server outputs cannot be recovered because they are not stored. Explicit retry is a new request and may spend another credit. No trial or automatic top-ups. Purchases are non-refundable, subject to rights required by law; no custom refund workflow. Provider reversals and disabled licenses revoke affected entitlements.

title: Retention and Recovery
html: Request IDs, input hashes and health metadata are retained for 30 days with periodic cleanup. Payment and credit ledgers remain for entitlement and financial reconciliation. Prompt bodies and generated outputs are never persisted by the gateway and cannot be recovered. Your local profile and files remain until you delete them or remove browser storage. External providers have their own retention policies.

title: Browser Permissions
html: storage and unlimitedStorage save local profiles, files, settings and privileged credentials. tabs and webNavigation coordinate sessions, navigation and embedded form agents. Website access scans and fills applications including frames. Host permissions permit HTTPS to the gateway and OpenRouter; Firefox requests website access at setup. No debugger, stealth logic, spoofing, external browser controller or CAPTCHA solving is used.

title: Collection and Sharing
html: Kareer does not sell applicant data or run advertising or browsing-history analytics. It retains the billing and managed AI accounting metadata described above. It does not continuously upload profiles or documents. The fictional website demo makes no AI requests. Website, infrastructure, payment and AI providers have their own policies.

title: Your Controls
html: Edit or delete local profiles and files in the extension. Activate the emailed key after reinstalling to regain the wallet; this does not restore files. Uninstalling or removing a key does not cancel billing. Use Manage billing or your Lemon Squeezy receipt to cancel, update payment details or recover keys. No custom accounts, email delivery or manual recovery tooling. Never post personal information or keys in bug reports.

title: Third-Party Services
html: Managed AI uses Cloudflare, Lemon Squeezy, OpenRouter and downstream providers. BYOK uses OpenRouter and your chosen provider. Their policies govern their processing. Application sites receive answers and files you enter or submit.

title: Security and Review
html: The gateway verifies payment state, caps requests, reserves credits transactionally and validates output structure before settlement. Structural validation does not guarantee factual accuracy. Review inferred and guessed answers. Auto Submit defaults off. See SECURITY.md.

title: Open Source
html: The extension, userscript and gateway source are in the Kareer repository under MIT, with third-party notices preserved.

title: Contact and Vulnerability Reporting
html: Report bugs without personal information through GitHub Issues. Report vulnerabilities privately using GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting. Billing/key recovery uses Lemon Squeezy receipts and its portal.
